description: Registry of installable Agentic Beaver community skills. An agent reads this file, picks a skill by id, and copies skills/<path>/ into its own skills directory, then follows that skill's SKILL.md.

install.how: For a chosen skill, copy the entire folder at skills/<path>/ into your agent's skills directory (e.g. .../skills/<id>/), then read its SKILL.md. Each skill is self-contained: SKILL.md + optional docs/, references/, scripts/.

skills.name: Cold Email — Full Outbound Pipeline
skills.description: End-to-end cold outbound sales pipeline: SCRAPE → ENRICH → CRM → RESEARCH → WRITE → SEND, plus reply and objection handling.

skills.name: Babysit PR
skills.description: Monitor a pull request through CI, automated review, conflict handling, and merge readiness without noisy polling.

skills.name: Council
skills.description: Bring in three strong delegates from different model providers for independent review and synthesis.

skills.name: File PR
skills.description: Review a branch diff and open a concise, human-readable pull request with safe attribution.

skills.name: Full Send
skills.description: Take a coding task from implementation through proof, review, PR monitoring, and merge without supervision.

skills.name: Full Stop
skills.description: Take a coding task through proof and PR readiness, but leave the final merge to the user.

skills.name: Leaving PR Comments
skills.description: Format concise, transparent agent-authored GitHub comments posted on a user's behalf.

skills.name: Modernize PR
skills.description: Reassess and safely rebase an aging pull request against the current product and codebase.

skills.name: Sol Loop
skills.description: Run bounded GPT Sol review rounds over a code diff, fix verified findings, and prevent review-driven scope creep.

skills.name: Takeover
skills.description: Take responsibility for an existing PR, branch, or agent thread while preserving contributor credit and intent.
